en.html:
YOU are standing stock-still.

All around, a landscape you recognise...
But recognise it from where? What place was this?

Something...
Very good. WHAT?

　何かを……

en.html:
First of all, what exactly is this 'you'?
This person who thinks the scenery is familiar, who thinks there is something to find—who is doing all this thinking?
en.text:

ja.html:
そもそも、<ruby>あなた<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>は何だ？
　辺りの景色に覚えがあると思い、何かを探している
と思う、この人格は何者だろう？
ja.text:

en.html:
Chalo. Walk, at least. Somehow you have a rough idea of what is where. And... you must not waste time. No evidence for it, but you believe it completely: hurry. Something has to be found, and quickly. Otherwise you LOSE. ...So hurry. Whatever this purpose is, fulfil it urgently. Understanding it can catch up. Where will you go?
Choices
  • The large mansion.
  • The edge of town.
  • The hill behind town.

とにかく歩こう。 　何処に何があるのか、あなたは何となく、わかって いる。 　それに……時間を潰していてはいけないのだ。 　あなたは根拠もなく信じている。急がなければなら ない――急いで何かを見つけ出さなくてはならない、 と。 　そうしなくては負ける・・・。 　……急ごう。 　何かわからぬ目的を至急、遂げよう。 　何処へ行く？
